info.name: Marketplace Nigeria API - Complete
info.description:
Complete API collection for Marketplace Nigeria with sample data

**Base URLs:**
- Local: http://127.0.0.1:8030
- Production: https://www.marketplace.ng

**Authentication:**
Most endpoints require Bearer token. Login first to get your token.

**All requests include sample data - ready to test!**

**Version:** 3.2
**Generated:** 2026-01-21 (Updated Routes)

exec: console.log("✅ Auth token saved to environment");

request.description:
🌐 **Public Endpoint**

Endpoint: `GET /api/adverts/{id}/related`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\AdvertController@related`

Returns paginated ads related to the given `ad_id`, ordered by relevance:
1. Same sub-category **and** similar title (highest priority)
2. Same sub-category only
3. Similar title only

**URL parameter:**
- `id`: The `ad_id` of the source advert (not the DB primary key)

**Query parameters:**
- `page` (optional, default 1)
- `per_page` (optional, default 20, max 40)

**Web equivalent:** `GET /related/{ad_id}`

**Response shape:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 10,
      "ad_id": 54321,
      "ad_title": "iPhone 14 Pro 256GB",
      "price": 500000,
      "contact_price": "no",
      "price_type": "Fixed",
      "state": "Lagos",
      "state_slug": "lagos",
      "title_slug": "iphone-14-pro-256gb",
      "category": 4,
      "sub_category": 6,
      "buy_direct": "No",
      "featured": "No",
      "sold": "No",
      "views": 120,
      "image_thumb": "https://marketplace.ng/...",
      "image_optimized": "https://marketplace.ng/..."
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "total": 45,
    "page": 1,
    "per_page": 20,
    "has_more": true,
    "source_ad": {
      "ad_id": 12345,
      "ad_title": "iPhone 14 Pro",
      "category": 4,
      "sub_category": 6
    }
  }
}
```

🌐 **Public Endpoint**

Endpoint: `GET /api/adverts/seller/{seller_id}`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\AdvertController@sellerAdverts`

Returns the full seller storefront: profile info, ratings, follower count, member-since date, store URL (with name slug), and paginated active ads.

**URL parameter:**
- `seller_id`: The seller's 5-character user_id (e.g. `82261`)

**Query parameters:**
- `per_page` (optional, default 20): ads per page
- `page` (optional, default 1): page number

**Web equivalent:** `GET /seller/{name-slug}/{seller_id}`
e.g. `/seller/john-doe/82261`

**Response shape:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "seller": {
      "user_id": "82261",
      "name": "John Doe",
      "slug": "john-doe",
      "store_url": "https://example.com/seller/john-doe/82261",
      "avatar_url": "...",
      "acc_type": "Private",
      "verified": false,
      "city": "Ikeja",
      "state": "Lagos",
      "member_since": "November 2024",
      "followers": 12,
      "ads_count": 5,
      "feedback": {
        "review_count": 8,
        "satisfaction": { "label": "Highly", "color": "bg-green-100" },
        "friendly":     { "label": "Highly", "color": "bg-green-100" },
        "reliable":     { "label": "Fairly", "color": "bg-yellow-100" }
      }
    },
    "ads": { ... paginated advert list ... }
  }
}
```

🌐 **Public Endpoint**

Endpoint: `GET /api/adverts/load-more`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\AdvertController@loadMore`

Loads paginated adverts using `FeaturedAdPaginator`. Page 1 interleaves featured (boosted) ads; subsequent pages return regular ads only.

**Query Params:**
- `page` (integer, default: 1) — page number
- `category`, `sub_category`, `brand`, `state`, `state_slug`, `city` — optional filters

**Response shape:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": { "ads": [...] },
  "pagination": {
    "has_more": true,
    "next_page": 3,
    "current_page": 2,
    "per_page": 24,
    "total": 150,
    "last_page": 7
  }
}
```

Get details for direct purchase including ad info, authenticated user, and available states.

**Authentication:** Required (Bearer token)

**Response includes:**
- Ad details with images and shipping options

Get payment details for direct purchase with shipping information.

**Authentication:** Required (Bearer token)

**Request Body:**
- `shipping_method_id` (required, integer): Selected shipping method ID
- `shipping_data` (required, object): Shipping and delivery information

  - `recipient_phone`: Phone number
  - `delivery_address`: Street address
  - `state`: State name
  - `city`: City name
  - `postal_code`: Postal/ZIP code

**Response includes:**
- Ad details
- User information
- Shipping method details
- Shipping data for confirmation

request.description:
🌐 **Public Endpoint**

Endpoint: `GET /api/categories/{category_slug}`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\AdvertController@categoryAdverts`

Returns paginated ads for a category using `FeaturedAdPaginator`. Page 1 includes featured/boosted ads.

**Response shape:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": { "ads": [...], "cat": {...}, "count_cat": 120, "subcategories": [...] },
  "pagination": {
    "has_more": true,
    "next_page": 2,
    "current_page": 1,
    "per_page": 24,
    "total": 120,
    "last_page": 5
  }
}
```

📱 **Mobile Endpoint — Public**

Endpoint: `GET /api/categories/{category_slug}/subcategories`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\AdvertController@categorySubcategories`

Returns all subcategories under a category with live ad counts and a representative thumbnail image from the first active ad in each subcategory. Designed for the mobile category-browse screen (subcategory list view).

**Path params:**
- `category_slug` — e.g. `vehicles`, `phones-tablets`

**Response shape:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "category": {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "Vehicles",
    "slug": "vehicles",
    "total_ads": 45230
  },
  "subcategories": [
    {
      "id": 2,
      "name": "Cars",
      "slug": "cars",
      "advert_count": 12500,
      "thumbnail_url": "https://..."
    }
  ],
  "total": 8
}
```

**Notes:**
- Subcategories are sorted **alphabetically** by name
- `thumbnail_url` is `null` if no active ads exist in that subcategory
- `advert_count` only counts active, non-recently-sold ads
- No pagination — all subcategories returned in a single response

🌐 **Public Endpoint**

Endpoint: `POST /api/search`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\SearchController@search`

**Request Body:**
- `product` (string, optional): Search term for product name or ad ID
- `location` (string, optional): State/location name
- `category` (integer, optional): Category ID
- `sub_category` (integer, optional): Sub-category ID
- `brand` (integer, optional): Brand ID
- `buydirect` (string, optional): Buy direct filter (yes/no)
- `per_page` (integer, optional): Items per page (default: 10)
- `page` (integer, optional): Page number (default: 1)

🌐 **Public Endpoint**

Endpoint: `POST /api/search/filter-by-car`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\SearchController@filterByCarDetails`

**Request Body:**
- `condition` (optional): "Brand New", "Nigerian Used", "Foreign Used"
- `fuel_type` (optional): "Petrol", "Diesel", "Electric", "Hybrid"
- `transmission` (optional): "Automatic", "Manual"
- `registration` (optional): "Registered", "Unregistered"
- `category`, `sub_category`, `brand`, `location`, `min`, `max`, `per_page` (optional)

🌐 **Public Endpoint**

Endpoint: `POST /api/search/filter-by-phone`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\SearchController@filterByPhoneDetails`

**Request Body:**
- `condition` (optional): "Brand New", "Nigerian Used", "Foreign Used", "Refurbished"
- `device_type` (optional): "Smartphone", "Feature Phone", "Tablet"
- `category`, `sub_category`, `brand`, `location`, `min`, `max`, `per_page` (optional)

🌐 **Public Endpoint**

Endpoint: `GET /api/search/location/{location}/{slug}`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\SearchController@locationSearch`

Resolves `slug` as a category, subcategory, or brand slug and returns paginated ads scoped to `{location}` (state name).

**Path Params:**
- `location` — state name (e.g. `Lagos`)
- `slug` — category_slug, sub_cat_slug, or brand_slug

**Query Params:**
- `page` (integer, default: 1)
- `per_page` (integer, default: 10)

**Response shape:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [...],
  "pagination": {
    "current_page": 1,
    "last_page": 4,
    "per_page": 10,
    "total": 38,
    "has_more": true
  }
}
```

🔒 **Requires Authentication**

Endpoint: `GET /api/user/notifications`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\UserStatsController@getNotifications`

Returns the authenticated user's in-app notifications and unread count.

**Response shape:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "notifications": [
      {
        "id": 93,
        "user_id": 3,
        "seller_id": 2,
        "advert_id": 352,
        "type": "New Ad",
        "message": "Noble has placed the ad \"Toyota Highlander\"",
        "is_read": 0,
        "created_at": "2026-02-19T21:53:25.000000Z"
      }
    ],
    "unread_count": 21
  }
}
```

🔒 **Requires Authentication**

Endpoint: `DELETE /api/user/delete-notification/{id}`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\UserController@deleteNotification`

Deletes a single notification. Users can only delete their own notifications — attempting to delete another user's notification returns 404.

**URL parameter:**
- `id`: The notification's integer ID

**Success response (200):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Notification deleted"
}
```

**Not found / wrong owner (404):**
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Notification not found"
}
```

🔒 **Requires Authentication**

Endpoint: `GET /api/user/wishlist`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\UserController@wishlist`

Returns the authenticated user's paginated wishlist (active adverts only).

**Response shape:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "current_page": 1,
    "data": [ { ...advert with firstImage... } ],
    "total": 5,
    "per_page": 20
  }

```

🔒 **Requires Authentication**

Endpoint: `POST /api/user/wishlist/{adId}`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\UserController@addToWishlist`

Adds an advert to the authenticated user's wishlist. No request body required.

**URL parameter:**
- `adId`: The advert's integer `id`

**Success (201):**
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "Added to wishlist successfully" }
```

**Already in wishlist (409):**
```json
{ "success": false, "message": "Already in wishlist" }
```

**Advert not found (404):**
```json
{ "success": false, "message": "Advert not found" }
```

🔒 **Requires Authentication**

Endpoint: `DELETE /api/user/wishlist/{adId}`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\UserController@removeFromWishlist`

Removes an advert from the authenticated user's wishlist.

**URL parameter:**
- `adId`: The advert's integer `id`

**Success (200):**
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "Removed from wishlist successfully" }
```

**Not in wishlist (404):**
```json
{ "success": false, "message": "Item not in wishlist" }
```

🔒 **Requires Authentication**

Endpoint: `POST /api/user/wishlist/{adId}/toggle`
Controller: `App\Http\Controllers\Api\UserController@toggleWishlist`

Adds the advert if it is not in the wishlist; removes it if it already is. Ideal for a single heart/bookmark button in the UI.

**URL parameter:**
- `adId`: The advert's integer `id`

**Added (200):**
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "Added to wishlist", "in_wishlist": true }
```

**Removed (200):**
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "Removed from wishlist", "in_wishlist": false }
```

**Advert not found (404):**
```json
{ "success": false, "message": "Advert not found" }
```

item.name: 13. Category UI Config

request.description:
Get UI configuration for a specific subcategory.

**Authentication:** Not required

**Note:** Subcategory rules are ADDITIVE to category rules

**Example Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "show": ["divCar", "divModel"],
    "hide": ["divPhone"],
    "labels": {
      "brand": "Select Car Brand:"
    },
    "required": ["model"]
  }
}
```

**Mobile Implementation:**
1. Fetch category config first
2. Apply category show/hide rules
3. Fetch subcategory config when user selects subcategory
4. Apply subcategory rules ON TOP of category rules
5. Show subcategory-specific sections (divCar, divPhone, etc.)
6. Mark fields in `required` array as mandatory

Clear the UI config cache (admin use only).

**Authentication:** Not enforced but intended for admin use

**Use Case:** After updating UI config in admin panel, call this to force refresh

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "UI config cache cleared successfully"
}
```

item.name: 10. Advertising
item.description:
**Public Advertising Endpoints**

Fetch and display active advertisement banners and sidebars in the mobile app.

**No authentication required.**

**Ad Types:**
- `banner` – Full-width horizontal ads (top/bottom of screen)
- `sidebar` – Smaller ads (in-feed or side panel)

**Integration Notes:**
- Poll this endpoint at app launch and cache for session duration
- Open `url` in an in-app browser on tap
- Record clicks via the click endpoint for analytics

request.description:
🌐 **Public Endpoint**

Endpoint: `GET /api/advertising?type=banner`

Fetch only banner-type advertisements.

**Use Case:** Display a rotating banner carousel at the top of the home screen.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "advert_id": 12345,
      "company": "Acme Ltd",
      "image_url": "https://marketplace.ng/uploads/advertising/banner.jpg",
      "url": "https://acme.com",
      "type": "banner",
      "expires_at": "2026-03-01 00:00:00",
      "days_remaining": 12
    }
  ],
  "total": 1
}
```

🌐 **Public Endpoint**

Endpoint: `GET /api/advertising?type=sidebar`

Fetch only sidebar-type advertisements.

**Use Case:** Display small promotional ads between listing cards in a feed.
